nodes.name: Render one asset at a time

parameters.content:
## Turn a podcast episode into captioned clips

### How it works
For podcast creators: read the newest RSS episode, transcribe a bounded audio sample, and ask OpenRouter to select highlights. Zvid produces vertical audiograms with episode artwork, original audio and timed captions. Review and publish the videos yourself; this workflow does not post to social accounts.

### Setup
1. Install **@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential using [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys), with Base URL **https://api.zvid.io**. Select it on the Zvid nodes and **Upload episode audio**.
3. Connect ElevenLabs Header Auth (**xi-api-key**, Speech to Text permission) to **Transcribe (Scribe)** and OpenRouter to **Pick moments**.
4. In **Config**, replace **feedUrl** with your podcast feed, then set **handle**, **clipCount** and **clipSeconds**. The default download is 4 MiB; **maxAudioBytes** must fit your Zvid plan. Only the transcribed sample can supply highlights.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. The optional draft branch requires a Zvid node version exposing **Project → Create**; transcription and AI can still incur charges. Test manually before enabling the daily schedule.

### Customization
Adjust artwork, fonts and colors in **Config**. Multipart audio upload uses HTTP Request because the published Zvid node does not expose it. [Full setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/podcast-audiogram-clips.md).

## 1. Choose the episode

Set your feed and clip limits in Config. The download and size check stop oversized audio before transcription; the daily schedule runs at 7am in the workflow timezone.

## 2. Transcribe and upload

Scribe returns word timings for the downloaded sample. Upload episode audio stores that same sample for rendering; select the Zvid API credential on this HTTP upload step.

## 3. Choose highlights and validate

OpenRouter selects timed passages. Prepare clips checks their timing, then Build project JSON adds artwork and captions; validation returns a credit quote before any render.

## 4. Preview or render

The default false branch renders. For dryRun=true, Save draft to editor requires Project → Create support in the installed Zvid node; the summary returns the editor link and quote.

nodes.name: 5. Render one clip at a time

parameters.content:
## 5. Render one clip at a time

Each accepted clip finishes before the next submission. Only explicit rate-limit rejections retry after a wait; polling and retry time are bounded by timeoutMinutes. Check Zvid before rerunning a timed-out job.

## 6. Watch the completed clips

Run summary keeps the completed video links. Open Watch video → Binary → data → View and select each output item. Missing links skip downloading; a preview failure preserves the completed render.
